title: data.pdf — section 69
text:
(4) The requirements of this subsection are met in relation to premises if there are
reasonable grounds to suspect that—
(a) there are items on the premises that are relevant evidence, and
(b) in a case where the premises are specified in the application, any of the
conditions in subsection (5) is met.

(5) The conditions referred to in subsection (4)(b) are—
(a) that it is not practicable to communicate with any person entitled to grant entry
to the premises;
(b) that it is not practicable to communicate with any person entitled to grant
access to the items;
(c) that entry to the premises is unlikely to be granted unless a warrant is
produced;
(d) that the purpose of entry may be frustrated or seriously prejudiced unless a
relevant enforcement officer arriving at the premises can secure immediate
entry to them.
